# ractermx_dmarc_compliance (Data Source)

Reads DMARC compliance data for a RacterMX domain.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (Number) The numeric ID of the domain.

### Read-Only

- `compliance_rate` (String) The DMARC compliance rate as a percentage string.
- `current_policy` (String) Current DMARC policy (none, quarantine, reject).
- `passed_messages` (Number) Messages that passed DMARC.
- `recommendation` (String) Policy recommendation from the advisor.
- `total_messages` (Number) Total messages evaluated.
